title: Receipt paragraph in house style from a fact sheet
final_text:
All residual hits are inside the explicit negation sentence ("no merit claim, ranking, score or scalar meter is issued here"), which the constraint section itself requires. Verification is complete.

**What I did:** Wrote `out/receipt.md`, a single one-paragraph ledger receipt `REC-20260914-V` in the house register (dense, declarative, evidence-first, no heading/list/table), opening exactly as specified. It carries, in prose: the **choice** (publish `contrast_triple_study_v2.py` + suite + occurrence-02 material/build script + source doc + appended PLAN section 15 and workflow section, then dispatch 20 calls on the cell occurrence-01 could not resolve), the **reason** (the `deepseek-flash` x `fcl` cell's 1-of-20 at the 8192 ceiling, called a resource observation and not a semantic one in those terms), the **contribution** (a new pre-registration with its own `plan_id`, never an amendment, so the 85-row-table claim is public before any reply exists), and the **state: PENDING**, with the publication evidence (commit `2d7239ac…`, tree `9d0ab88f…`, read back via `git ls-remote`). Every suite number sits beside its full `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -X utf8 -m unittest …` invocation, and byte-mode append is stated per `operations.md`. Occurrence-01 is asserted to stand as published; the `fcl`/`prose` arms are named two occasions, never competitors; no score/rank/meter appears.

**Last verification run:** the `python3 -c` checks — all fact-sheet hashes, counts, paths, required phrases and the exact opening prefix are present; the file is exactly one paragraph; forbidden terms appear only inside the required negation sentence. All checks pass.

**Facts deliberately left out of the paragraph, and why:**
- The full 64-hex sha256 of each file beyond the first (`1857110385da…` given in full; `18571103…`/`f5f9dfca…`/`1ba7be08…`/`94edfe61…` cited in the sheet's own short form where the sheet itself truncates, e.g. for `helper_sha256` and the provenance `cmp`) — keeps the paragraph readable; each short form is unique in the sheet.
- `resolved_from /home/user/miniReason/src` was included; I omitted repeating `git ls-remote`'s target URL form — the read-back command is quoted in full instead.
- The individual reasoning-token spread per coordinate beyond the sheet's own summary (eleven at 8192, nine between 5488 and 7890) — the sheet gives no finer figures, and adding none respects "no figure it does not contain."
- The trailing `...` inside the quoted `dispatch_scope` dict — quoted verbatim as the sheet prints it, since the sheet itself elides the remaining keys.
- The 20-of-20 prose figure's use as a control ("which ceiling, not family, caused it") — included as a fact but deliberately not turned into any comparison of the arms, per the no-competition rule.
- No figure about byte counts or file sizes of the commit (not present in the sheet), and no statement that `main` publication is pending merge or any working-branch mandate language (the sheet says neither), omitted to honour "add no fact the sheet does not contain."
